g.text: Drill-down throughput · two ways to express the same work

g.text: Fixed 113.2B-quote dataset · D1 + D2 · About 89.4M quotes read per query
Total measured bytes or read rows / total server execution time. Both drill-downs included equally; idle gaps excluded.
Only rows actually processed count; data skipped by the primary index is excluded. Warm data cache; result cache off.
Parallelism set with max_threads on a fixed 59-vCPU / 236-GiB service. 12 rounds; shading shows IQR.
